title: Rami bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.20b.15), and Hyman writes that it seems the text should read Rami bar Abba, or else he is Ami bar Avin, who is mentioned in [Keritot 20a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.20a.11).[^1]

notes.text: Shabbat has Rami bar Avin defining itran, and [an earlier passage on the page](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.20b.3) names Rami bar Abba in a different discussion. Keritot names Ami bar Avin. [Heilprin’s Ami entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=571&lang=en) likewise suggests reading Ami in Shabbat.
